scope: Pinned ULike 5.6.2(740) original APK static ownership audit; no device claim

native_capture_callback.safe_release_boundary: after owned rendered source (or new watermark canvas), per-shot settings/context, private save controller and notification are established; serial borrowed input does not release early

shortcut_restrictions: hasGainmap false (or API has no such method)
watermark_copy_reduction.normalization_rollback_source: pristine owned source retained; no in-place mutation of fallback source

pipeline.encoding_permit: before codec Builder.build, before deferred SaveFd prep task can allocate codec
pipeline.stage_ticket: original ExitJobs prep lease begins at its old location; queued abandon releases it on normalize failure
pipeline.next_stage_start: only after final normalized/detailed dimensions pass and encode permit acquired
pipeline.available_memory_requirement: Explicitly subtract tracked input Bitmap native allocation plus anticipated final allocation from Java headroom; also limit by ActivityManager physical availMem minus threshold and block lowMemory. Require remaining headroom >= 72 MiB + max(queued/current input and snapshotted/planned output pixels) * 24 bytes.
pipeline.native_bitmap_accounting: Input getAllocationByteCount plus snapshotted output186 target estimate; after final normalization, replace estimate with actual final allocation, without double-counting if same Bitmap. Queue costs removed when terminal worker releases ownership.
pipeline.fixed_output_budget: Input dimensions, source metadata and output186(width,height,rotation,fixedSnapshot) all included before normalization; current configured next reader uses live output186 dimensions as extra admission guard.

completion.manager_controller_binding: temporary exact controller within single main callback
completion.exit_guard_released: after main receipt finishes, or immediately if main post failed
completion.failed_correction_fifo: Every queued save Job takes its FIFO encoder terminal turn even when correction fails before encoding. Captured-source preparation failures retain original failure toast/capture-release route and do not generate a native saved-file receipt.
completion.ownership_transfer_failure: After queue submission, optional early memory probe failure cannot release reservation twice.
